notes: These hashes describe all four advancing-clock runs; prior fixed-clock boundary runs retain their original metadata in 2026-10-17-material-boundary-runs.json.

All runs passed process guards. Lit and shadow are separate full workloads, not additive. No presentation or gameplay FPS measurement.
